title: Tom Hicks, the Texas businessman who owned Stars, Rangers and Liverpool teams, dies at 79
summary: DALLAS (AP) — Tom Hicks, the Texas businessman and philanthropist who owned two Dallas-area professional sports franchises and an English Premier League soccer team, died Saturday.
